question: Which deities should be placed on the middle and right leaves respectively?
premises: The middle leaf is a designated location
Rudra is to be placed on the middle leaf
Brahmā is to be placed on the right leaf
inference: One should place Rudra on the middle leaf and Brahmā on the right leaf.
